responsibility: This header declares C-specific language-side GC-managed data structures attached to GCC tree nodes and function state. It defines the lang_type payload used for sorted record fields, enum min/max values, and Objective-C-related record metadata, the per-function language_function state saved across nested-function contexts, and OpenMP declare-target bookkeeping types and globals used by the C front end.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the data-structure declaration side of the c-lang pair: it defines lang_type, language_function, and related GTY-managed C front-end state, while gcc/c/c-lang.cc is the implementation file that instantiates the C lang_hooks and C-only hook behavior rather than these type layouts.
